description: This file defines the LoanProductRelatedDetailMinimumData class, which encapsulates detailed information related to loan products in the Fineract platform, including interest rates, amortization, repayment schedule, and various grace periods.

classes.name: LoanProductRelatedDetailMinimumData
classes.description: A data class representing minimum related details of a loan product, including interest rates, grace periods, amortization, and repayment schedule configurations.

methods.name: defaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Converts an Integer zero value to null, otherwise returns the original value.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the currency information associated with the loan product.

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestCharged
methods.description: Returns the grace period on interest charged.

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestPayment
methods.description: Returns the grace period on interest payment.

methods.name: getGraceOnPrincipalPayment
methods.description: Returns the grace period on principal payment.

methods.name: getRecurringMoratoriumOnPrincipalPeriods
methods.description: Returns the number of periods for recurring moratorium on principal.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the interest rate per period.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the frequency type for interest periods.

methods.name: getAnnualNominalInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual nominal interest rate.

methods.name: getInterestMethod
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation method.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationPeriodMethod
methods.description: Returns the method used for interest calculation periods.

methods.name: getRepayEvery
methods.description: Returns the interval at which repayments occur.

methods.name: getRepaymentPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the frequency type for repayment periods.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Returns the total number of repayments.

methods.name: getAmortizationMethod
methods.description: Returns the amortization method used for the loan.

methods.name: isAllowPartialPeriodInterestCalculation
methods.description: Indicates whether partial period interest calculation is permitted.

methods.name: isInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Indicates whether interest is recognized on disbursement date.

methods.name: getDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Returns the custom strategy for days in year calculation.

methods.name: getDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the value for days in month type.

methods.name: getDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the value for days in year type.
